$comment: Three paths have to be served from aussieauth.com rather than the Convex
deployment, because a third party checks them against the domain:
Apple verifies the domain owns its return URL, and a browser fetches
/.well-known/webauthn from the passkey relying party's own domain.
The deployment hostname is hardcoded because Vercel does not interpolate
environment variables into rewrite destinations. If the Convex deployment
ever changes, these three lines must change with it or Sign in with Apple
and cross-domain passkeys break silently. Get it from `convex dev`.
